description: DiligenceOps: submit a non-disclosure agreement, as text, fields (direction, parties, definition, carve_outs, term, survival, residuals, governing_law) or both. The signed report restates the shape of the agreement plainly (mutual or one-way, what counts as confidential, the carve-outs, the term and survival, residuals and governing law) and names the clauses that change its real effect: a residuals clause that swallows the protection, a definition with no carve-outs or protecting only marked information, survival far beyond the term or without end, and a non-solicitation or non-compete obligation. POST /api/nda-evidence-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. The report matches words, figures, dates and named items between the submitted texts; it does not interpret meaning beyond that matching. Contract: /api/diligence-assurance-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

inputSchema.description: Send the agreement, the fields or both.

agreement.description: The non-disclosure agreement as text or HTML, up to 256 KB.

fields.description: The same material as fields. A field given here takes precedence over the document for that element.

direction.description: Whether the agreement is mutual or one-way, and who discloses.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

label.description: Optional name for the material, recorded in the report.

name: wever_nda-evidence-check
title: NDA evidence check
